title: rhodiola rotundata
intro: Rhodiola rotundata, commonly known as "Golden Root," is a type of flowering plant in the Rhodiola genus, which is native to the high-altitude mountainous regions of the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau in China and the Himalayas. This adaptogenic herb has been traditionally used to enhance mental performance, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Rhodiola rotundata are attributed to its adaptogenic properties, which help to regulate the body's response to stress, as well as its ability to improve mood, reduce fatigue, and enhance cognitive function. The bioactive constituents of Rhodiola rotundata include rosavin, salidroside, and tyrosol, which have been shown to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties.
